phase_1_result.title: Decisive symmetry/clique-closure probe with hard pivot gate
phase_1_result.outcome: GATE-C: neither a sorry-free exact-symmetry lemma (cs5FCIncest r -> r a b -> r b a) nor a countermodel was landed within the bounded single-run budget. Explicitly sanctioned non-failure terminal state per the plan's pivot gate.
evidence: Proof attempt: live lean_goal + lean_multi_attempt state (not hand analysis alone) confirms the hincest/hfour/hsymbox cascade never re-pins the two original fixed points -- e.g. htrans-chasing hab/hincest produces h7 : r b2 a (b <= b2, raised) instead of r b a; hfour hab hb_b1 h1 produces hvt : r v a (v >= a, raised) instead of r b a. aesop and tauto both fail outright. Independently reproduces the third dispatch's documented finding.

Countermodel attempt 1: hand-built r n m := (n>=2 v m>=2) v n=m v (n=0 ^ m=1) on Nat, checked against all five cs5FCIncest conjuncts by hand -- FAILS htrans (r 1 2 and r 2 0 both hold via the >=2 clause, forcing r 1 0 by transitivity, collapsing the intended asymmetry). Reproduces the documented hsymbox+htrans collapse pattern via an independent construction.

Countermodel attempt 2 (new this dispatch): translation-invariant difference-set analysis over Z (r n m := (m-n) in D) shows any additive sub-semigroup D containing 0, unbounded both above and below (the SB/IN requirements translated), is forced by a Bezout-plus-scaling argument to equal g*Z for some g>=1 -- a subgroup, hence symmetric. No translation-invariant countermodel exists. Does not by itself prove the fully general (non-translation-invariant Preorder) claim.

Zorn/chain-union pattern assessed and found structurally infeasible within this probe's budget: hfour/hsymbox take their raised point u' as a hypothesis (not an axiom-supplied existential -- only hincest's witness is existential), so there is no direct set-of-reachable-pairs poset whose maximal element pins the two ORIGINAL fixed points a, b exactly. Building one is genuinely new, multi-dispatch-scale infrastructure (plan's own ~150-300+ line estimate), not a bounded-probe-sized task.
